description: Defines data structures and classes for managing NGAP UE (User Equipment) context and context list, including identifiers, context management, and lookup functions within the NGAP protocol implementation.

classes.name: ngap_ue_context
classes.description: Represents the context of a UE in NGAP, including identifiers, timers, and related information.

classes.name: ngap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a collection of NGAP UE contexts, providing lookup, addition, removal, and ID allocation functionalities.

methods.name: get_cu_cp_ue
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the associated NGAP CU-CP UE notifier.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks existence of a UE by RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a UE context by RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a UE context by RAN UE ID or AMF UE ID, returning nullptr if not found.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE context with specified identifiers and notifier.

methods.name: update_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Updates the AMF UE ID associated with a given RAN UE ID.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index and notifier for a given UE.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Allocates and returns the next available RAN UE ID.
